title: BitDecoding-FP4: Native FP4 KV Cache Decoding via Algorithm-System Co-Design
abstract: arXiv:2611.09825v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The key-value (KV) cache dominates memory capacity and bandwidth in long-context LLM serving. While 4-bit microscaling formats (NVFP4, MXFP4) shrink the cache and run attention on FP4 Tensor Cores, a fundamental gap remains between algorithmic quantization and system-aware acceleration: existing FP4 KV systems use vanilla quantization that causes severe accuracy drops, whereas accuracy-oriented 4-bit algorithms rely on vector codebooks whose lookup overhead degrades decoding throughput. We present BitDecoding-FP4, an algorithm--system co-design for accurate and efficient native FP4 KV decoding. We mitigate three error sources: Dual-Residual Query Quantization splits queries into two FP4 tensors, cutting query logit error from 60% to 1%; Underflow-Aware Probability Scaling prevents E4M3 scales from rounding long-context probabilities to zero; and Outlier-Aware Key Quantization combines static smoothing, Hadamard rotation, and scale sear

translated_title: BitDecoding-FP4：通过算法-系统协同设计实现原生FP4 KV缓存解码
translated_abstract: 在长上下文大语言模型（LLM）服务中，键值（KV）缓存占据着内存容量和带宽的主导地位。虽然4位微缩放格式（NVFP4、MXFP4）能够缩小缓存体积并在FP4 Tensor Cores上运行注意力计算，但算法量化与系统感知加速之间仍存在根本性差距：现有的FP4 KV系统使用朴素量化，会导致严重的精度下降；而面向精度的4位量化算法则依赖向量码本，其查找开销会降低解码吞吐量。我们提出了BitDecoding-FP4，一种用于精确且高效的原生FP4 KV解码的算法-系统协同设计方法。我们缓解了三种误差来源：双残差查询量化将查询拆分为两个FP4张量，将查询logit误差从60%降至1%；下溢感知概率缩放防止E4M3缩放因子将长上下文概率舍入为零；离群值感知键量化结合了静态平滑、Hadamard旋转和缩放搜索……
tldr: BitDecoding-FP4通过算法-系统协同设计，结合双残差查询量化、下溢感知概率缩放和离群值感知键量化三项技术，实现了精确且高效的原生FP4 KV缓存解码，解决了现有方法在精度与吞吐量之间的权衡问题。
en_tdlr: BitDecoding-FP4 is an algorithm-system co-design that achieves accurate and efficient native FP4 KV cache decoding by mitigating three error sources through Dual-Residual Query Quantization, Underflow-Aware Probability Scaling, and Outlier-Aware Key Quantization, resolving the trade-off between accuracy and decoding throughput in existing approaches.
